findings.name: charging_unit
findings.note: SU corresponds to one compute core utilizing less than approximately 2GB of memory for one hour (see doc-anvil-jobs:c124:s2).

citations.title: Job Submission - RCAC Documentation
citations.heading: Job Submission - RCAC Documentation > Job Submission on Anvil ¶ > Job Accounting ¶ > CPU Nodes ¶
citations.quote: The charge unit for Anvil is the Service Unit (SU) .

findings.charging_model: Jobs are charged in Service Units (SU) per core-hour (1 SU ≈ one compute core with <~2GB memory for one hour). Partition charging factors apply (e.g., highmem charged at 4 SU per compute core; other partitions show a charging factor of 1).
findings.note: Partition table lists charging factors; highmem has factor 4 (doc-anvil-jobs:c24:s7) and doc-anvil-jobs:c129:s1 also documents highmem charged 4 SU per core.

citations.title: Job Submission - RCAC Documentation

citations.quote: This corresponds to the equivalent use of one compute core utilizing less than approximately 2G of data in memory for one hour.
